mapper.select: SELECT e.event_id, e.event_type, e.event_kind, e.title, e.subtitle, e.description, e.program_text, e.thumbnail_url, e.image_urls, e.links, e.reservation_url, e.pre_reservation, e.status, e.is_permanent, e.start_date, e.end_date, e.operating_hours, e.open_days, e.open_weekend, e.opens_late, e.venue_name, e.region1, e.region2, e.region3, e.address_road, e.latitude, e.longitude, e.has_photo_zone, e.is_experience, e.age_limit, e.is_free, e.price_text, e.has_benefit, e.reservable, e.contact, e.organizer FROM explore_items ei JOIN event e ON e.event_id = ei.item_id WHERE ei.item_type = 'EVENT' AND ei.item_id = #{eventId} AND ei.approval_status = 'APPROVED' AND ei.visibility_status = 'VISIBLE' AND ei.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.status IN ('SCHEDULED', 'ONGOING')

SELECT a.activity_id, a.activity_code,
CASE WHEN #{language} = 'en' THEN a.label_en ELSE a.label_ko END AS activity_name, s.sector_id, s.sector_code, CASE WHEN #{language} = 'en' THEN s.label_en ELSE s.label_ko END AS sector_name, ea.is_primary FROM event_activity ea JOIN activity a ON a.activity_id = ea.activity_id JOIN sector s ON s.sector_id = a.sector_id WHERE ea.event_id = #{eventId} AND ea.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY ea.is_primary DESC, s.display_order, a.display_order, a.activity_id

SELECT e.event_id AS item_id, e.event_kind, e.status, e.title, e.subtitle, e.thumbnail_url, e.region1, e.region2, e.region3, e.latitude, e.longitude, e.start_date, e.end_date FROM explore_items ei JOIN event e ON e.event_id = ei.item_id WHERE
ORDER BY e.view_count DESC, e.event_id DESC
ORDER BY e.end_date IS NULL, e.end_date ASC, e.event_id DESC
ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.event_id DESC
LIMIT #{request.size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM explore_items ei JOIN event e ON e.event_id = ei.item_id WHERE
